title: Theogene Baquet, his son George, and the Papa Tio clowning family
summary: Excelsior leader Baquet who died in Texas, his son the clown, and Papa Tio and Lorenzo, who played with him.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Is that how you pronounce his name? Theo Gene? No, no, the old man, the father. Theo Gene. Do you know Theo Gene Bakke? Oh yes. He was the Excelsior Band's leader. He had a good band. And what did he play?
He died in Texas.
I remember. What kind of instrument he played?
He played, he flattered. He flattered. Ask him if he knew his songs. Yes. He flattered. He had a good band.
And what did he play?
He died in Texas, I believe.
What kind of instrument he played?
He played E-flat.
Ask him if he knew his sons. You knew his sons?
Huh?
You knew any of his sons?
Yeah, his son died. He was the finest clown ever had in town.
That's right. That's right.
What was his name? What was his name?
His name was back there. George. George was back there.
That's right. He was. He was the best too. Did he know the Teos? Did he know Papa Teo?
Did you know Papa Teo? Who? Papa Teo.
Papa Teo.
Papa Teo.
Oh yeah, they were street clowning. Papa and Lorenzo. They had a young fella. What was his name?
Lorenzo. Lorenzo Junior. Junior. Where did they come from? Good ones. All good ones. That's where they came from.
Where they came from? Was this their hometown? Huh? Was this their hometown? They were born and raised in New Orleans or wait?
Who?
Teo Papa.
They were born here in New Orleans. Ask him if they played in the street or much.
Did they play in the street?
Did they play on the streets much music, you know? Out on the streets like parades and different things? They played everything.
Did he work with them?
Did you ever play with them? With me? Yeah.
Yeah, I played with, they played with me. Okay. In what? I used to hire them all the time. What band was this? What band?
You knew the name of the band? Or they played with you? What band they played in your band? Oh, well.
Sometimes we didn't have no name for the band. We just get the bands, you know? Mixed them up. I did. But there was regular fellas used to play with good bands, you know?
